title: kith-attach: BlobStore has no enforcement that base_dir exists at I/O time
description: BlobStore::new() accepts any PathBuf without checking existence. init() creates the directory but is never called automatically. If the caller omits init(), or if base_dir is deleted after init(), every read_blob/write_blob call fails with an OS error (NotFound or similar) that surfaces as an uncontextualised io::Error to callers. A lazy-init check in blob_path() or a clear contract in the API doc (and an assertion) would prevent silent misdirection.
